context: Two managers prep an end-of-year ceremony
purpose: Teach: 抽選/移籍/攻略/収納/主観/賛同/真摯/表彰

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 表彰式、抽選イベントも盛り込もう。
lines.en: Let's build a ceremony that includes a lottery draw as well.
lines.style: Efficient, forward-thinking. Crisp opening. Speaking with quiet authority—planning mode. No hesitation. Clean, declarative rhythm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 移籍組のスピーチも、真摯な内容で組み込みます。
lines.en: I'll incorporate thoughtful speeches from the transfer staff.
lines.style: Steady, assured nod of commitment. Mid-register, no flourish. Words landing with quiet reliability. The tone of someone who takes notes and follows through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 攻略レビューは、主観を排した形で資料化を。
lines.en: For the review analysis, format everything objectively—strip out any personal bias.
lines.style: Precise and exacting. Light snap of conviction on 'objectively.' Speaking to a capable colleague—no need to over-explain. Efficient pacing. The voice of someone who sets standards.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。賛同が得られた案だけ採用です。
lines.en: Understood. We'll only move forward with proposals that have buy-in.
lines.style: Measured agreement with understated confidence. Affirming the standard she's set. Even, purposeful pace. The reliability of someone who mirrors competence back to you.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 機材は会場の収納に事前搬入しておこう。
lines.en: We should get the equipment staged in the venue's storage ahead of time.
lines.style: Clear operational thinking. Brisk, matter-of-fact delivery. Each phrase sits squarely on the beat. No ambiguity—this is happening. The voice of logistical control.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Tight, final confirmation. Brief exhale of acknowledgment. The full stop of someone ready to move to the next task.
